content.about: Türkiye spans two continents, with most of its land in Asia and a small part in Europe. Istanbul sits on both sides of the Bosphorus strait. It has ancient cities, fairy-chimney rock towers in Cappadocia and long coastlines on four seas. Turkish coffee, tea and sweets like baklava are famous worldwide.

standout.text: Göbekli Tepe, about 11,000 years old, is one of the oldest known monumental temples.

didYouKnow: Istanbul is one of the few major cities that lies on two continents.
Tulips were grown in the Ottoman Empire before they became popular in the Netherlands.
Santa's inspiration, Saint Nicholas, lived in Myra, in today's Türkiye.
